text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, looks good! The floor and chairs are 
sparkling! Perfection☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, that took quite a while. Even with 
cleaning staff around, with this much foot 
traffic, it's bound to happen.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate, I have a feeling the 
other spots won't end up squeaky clean 
either!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, might as well clean the demon 
gate while I'm at it! Time to work hard 
for everyone's good fortune!
